title: Masking limits
description: The longest run of digits that may appear unmasked, for one pack, as data (Architect ruling A154 as corrected, relayed and not yet committed; PERD 31.2 check 4 and the error-scanner requirement: no digit run longer than 4). One source for the core's redactor, the explanation validator and the error-scanner test, and for the model service's redactor (AGENT-16: agents do not set thresholds, so no number lives in code). The ruling caps every outward surface at four, so the contract admits exactly 4: a longer run is masked to its last four digits, and no consumer can validate a looser policy. Typed IDs, RFC 3339 timestamps and number-typed structured fields are exempt by type, not by this value (the list is the Security Reviewer's, noema#457). SYNTHETIC configuration (AGENT-25). A change of value is a new major version of this contract and a Founder decision.

pack_id.description: The pack's vertical prefix, as in pack.v1 pack_id.

max_unmasked_digit_run.description: The longest run of digits left unmasked: exactly 4, the digits a mask keeps (A154 as corrected).
